BiblicalUsage: Zobebah is a son of Coz, named in the genealogy of Judah. In 1 Chronicles 4:8, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Zobebah shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
